_doc: Item icon sheets (art bible §5.5 T9, 2x2, item kind: the item itself on a cloth, umber-black #241C14, warm lantern accent). Built into prompts by tools/assets/icon_sheets.py; split by tools/assets/icon_sheets.py split. Order = quadrants 1 top-left, 2 top-right, 3 bottom-left, 4 bottom-right.
template: 2x2 grid of four separate square fantasy game icons with wide dark gaps: 1. {s1}, 2. {s2}, 3. {s3}, 4. {s4}. Each icon: one bold central subject filling 70 percent of its square, lit from the upper left, strong value contrast, a warm lantern-light glow accent, simple dark umber-black (#241C14) vignette background, no border, no frame, no text, stylized hand-painted fantasy strategy game art, painterly brush texture, big simple readable shapes, bold clear silhouette, saturated harmonious colours, soft painted gradients, gentle top light painted into the colours, painted ambient occlusion, clean colour blocking with one or two main colours, game-ready asset
